# meSpeak.js (Modular eSpeak) v2.0.x

- meSpeak by Norbert Landsteiner (2011-2020), https://www.masswerk.at/mespeak
- Based on speak.js (https://github.com/kripken/speak.js) and eSpeak.

- Voice data files (voices/*.json) are eSpeak voice/dictionary data, GNU GPL v3.

Vendored 2026-08-23 for /utility-tools/text-to-speech.html client-side audio
file generation (WAV). No modifications to the upstream files.
